items.title: Bitcoin ETFs flip negative for 2026 after $1.28 billion outflow week, worst since June
items.summary: BlackRock's IBIT accounted for 98% of Friday's outflows, with $403 million leaving the industry-leading fund.

items.title: Russia finalizes crypto trading rules ahead of Nov. 17 rollout
items.summary: The rules allow retail investors to trade BTC, ETH and USDT through regulated intermediaries, with Moscow Exchange planning to launch crypto trading in December.

items.title: Strive buys 15,124 Bitcoin in October, closes in on top treasury holders
items.summary: Bitcoin treasury company Strive reported $509 million in third-quarter net income and purchased 15,124 BTC in October, bringing its total holdings to 43,124 BTC.

items.title: Crypto ETFs see over half a billion dollars in outflows amid post-midterm market slide
Bitcoin recovers $76,000 level as ETFs shed $430 million after tech rout
items.summary: Bitcoin recovered above $76,000 Friday after dropping below that level during Thursday's tech-driven market rout.

items.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs post $530M outflows as election gains evaporate
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs shed a combined $530 million Thursday as Bitcoin fell below $76,000 and US stocks tumbled.

items.title: Trump-Backed American Bitcoin Turns a Profit as Bitcoin Rise Lifts Books
items.summary: The Hut 8-backed miner reversed a second-quarter loss, driven largely by a $197 million gain on its Bitcoin holdings.

items.title: Solana Labs’ Leap Launches Mobile App for Trading Tokenized Stocks and Crypto
items.summary: Leap, built by the team behind Dialect, launched a beta iPhone app for trading tokenized stocks, ETFs, metals, currencies and crypto on Solana, pitching itself to traders looking beyond meme coins.
